reproduction_script:
"""Run from the repository root. Profile candidate ranking separately from fitting."""

import ast
import json
import platform
from importlib.metadata import version
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from sklearn_genetic import GAFeatureSelectionCV

baseline = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "b7f8757327af225ef02ecbcc3cdf503b753fb5ea"], text=True
).strip()
path = "sklearn_genetic/genetic_search.py"
source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{baseline}:{path}"], text=True)
method = next(
    fn
    for cls in ast.parse(source).body
    if getattr(cls, "name", "") == "_FinalSelectionMixin"
    for fn in cls.body
    if getattr(fn, "name", "") == "_top_candidate_indices"
)
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[method], type_ignores=[]), path, "exec"), globals())
current = GAFeatureSelectionCV._top_candidate_indices
rng = np.random.default_rng(1801)
rows = []
for size in (64, 4096, 32768):
    search = GAFeatureSelectionCV(DecisionTreeClassifier(), final_selection_top_k=3)
    search.refit_metric = "score"
    masks = rng.random((size, 12)) < 0.4
    masks[~masks.any(axis=1), 0] = True
    counts = list(masks.sum(axis=1))
    for shape in ("tied_leaders", "all_tied", "distinct_ranks"):
        ranks = np.arange(1, size + 1)
        if shape == "tied_leaders":
            ranks[:12] = 1
        elif shape == "all_tied":
            ranks[:] = 1
        search.cv_results_ = {"rank_test_score": ranks, "features": masks, "n_features": counts}
        assert list(current(search)) == list(_top_candidate_indices(search))
        measurements = [[], []]
        for repeat in range(9):
            for i in ((0, 1) if repeat % 2 == 0 else (1, 0)):
                fn = (_top_candidate_indices, current)[i]
                start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                for _ in range(10):
                    fn(search)
                measurements[i].append((time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 10000)
        rows.append(
            dict(
                size=size,
                shape=shape,
                baseline_us=statistics.median(measurements[0]),
                current_us=statistics.median(measurements[1]),
            )
        )
# Differential coverage of repeated masks, inconsistent ranks across repeats, ties and cutoff sizes.
for _ in range(500):
    size = int(rng.integers(3, 130))
    masks = rng.integers(0, 2, size=(size, 5), dtype=np.int8).astype(bool)
    masks[~masks.any(axis=1), 0] = True
    search.final_selection_top_k = int(rng.integers(1, 40))
    search.cv_results_ = {
        "rank_test_score": rng.integers(1, 10, size=size),
        "features": masks,
        "n_features": masks.sum(axis=1),
    }
    assert list(current(search)) == list(_top_candidate_indices(search))
X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)


class ReferenceSearch(GAFeatureSelectionCV):
    _top_candidate_indices = _top_candidate_indices


with threadpool_limits(1):
    for criterion in ("min", "max"):
        opts = dict(
            criteria=criterion,
            cv=2,
            scoring="accuracy",
            population_size=6,
            generations=2,
            random_state=1801,
            verbose=False,
            n_jobs=1,
            final_selection=True,
        )
        before, after = [
            cls(DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=2, random_state=1801), **opts).fit(X, y)
            for cls in (ReferenceSearch, GAFeatureSelectionCV)
        ]
        assert (
            before.final_selection_results_["candidates"]
            == after.final_selection_results_["candidates"]
        )
        assert before.best_index_ == after.best_index_
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(before.predict(X), after.predict(X))
print(
    json.dumps(
        dict(
            baseline=baseline,
            python=platform.python_version(),
            versions={p: version(p) for p in ("numpy", "scikit-learn", "deap")},
            rows=rows,
            reproduction_script=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        ),
        indent=2,
    )
)
